name: Digiter Builder Lite
author: digiterorg

sections.description:
Website: digiter.org | Full version / Shop

Digiter Builder Lite provides 36 content and layout modules and 4 bundled templates. Build with sections, columns, headings, text, images, buttons, galleries, tabs, accordions and more. Preview responsive layouts, save drafts and publish explicitly.

Included tools work without payment, a license key, registration or a time limit. Shared styles, reusable components, saved versions and design package import/export are included. AI generation and the commercial updater are not included. Plugin updates use WordPress.org.

Buy the Full version from WordPress

Administrators can open Full version under the plugin menu or use Buy Full version on the Plugins screen. Open Digiter Shop, choose Digiter Builder, review the current price and renewal terms, and complete checkout on digiter.org. Recurring plans require a verified Digiter Account. Download the Full ZIP and license from the order or Customer Account. Back up your site, test on staging, deactivate Lite, and install the Full ZIP through Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin. Activate the license in the Full plugin’s License screen.

Lite and Full use separate storage identifiers. There is no automatic conversion of Lite layouts into the Full edition. Keep your backup and verify existing content on staging before switching.

All Lite features remain free. These are ordinary optional links: Lite makes no new external requests and never downloads or installs premium code. Full version documentation.

External services and privacy

No license or telemetry request is required for authoring. Optional external operations are:
* Font catalogue: an authorized user’s explicit refresh request retrieves font metadata from fonts.google.com and, as a fallback, s.w.org (WordPress.org’s font collection). These providers receive the requested URL, server IP address and normal HTTP metadata. The returned JSON is parsed as font metadata, never executed as code. Browsing the bundled or previously saved catalogue makes no catalogue request. WordPress.org privacy: https://wordpress.org/about/privacy/ . Google terms: https://policies.google.com/terms . Google Fonts privacy: https://developers.google.com/fonts/faq/privacy .
* Font installation: an authorized user explicitly selects a font to download from fonts.googleapis.com and fonts.gstatic.com. Google receives the requested family, font variant, server IP address and normal HTTP metadata. Installed fonts and generated CSS are served locally; visiting a published page does not request Google Fonts. Terms: https://policies.google.com/terms . Privacy: https://developers.google.com/fonts/faq/privacy .
* Sound packs: Kenney supplies optional CC0 audio packs. Only an authorized user’s explicit install request downloads a pack. Kenney receives the requested pack URL, server IP address and normal HTTP connection metadata; audio files are then served locally. No account is required. Terms: https://kenney.nl/terms-of-service . Privacy: https://kenney.nl/privacy-policy .
* Maps: OpenStreetMap supplies embedded maps when an author adds a map module. Loading the map sends the configured coordinates and map bounds, visitor IP address and browser connection metadata to OpenStreetMap. With the module’s consent option enabled, the request occurs only after the visitor selects “Load map from OpenStreetMap”; otherwise it occurs when the embedded map loads. Terms: https://osmfoundation.org/wiki/Terms_of_Use . Privacy: https://osmfoundation.org/wiki/Privacy_Policy .
* Diagnostics are local only. Lite never sends reports to an external server. Administrators can inspect, disable, clear or download a JSON report. The download contains the site URL, software inventory and sanitized technical events. Local records are bounded and retained for up to 14 days (cleanup requires WordPress cron).
* User-authored remote media or design-source URLs: only the URLs you select are requested. Remote media viewers disclose connection metadata to that host. Review the host’s privacy terms before using remote content.

Source and licenses

Original PHP and JavaScript sources are included. Third-party notices are in docs and assets/vendor. Bundled fonts include their OFL licenses. Lottie upstream source: https://github.com/airbnb/lottie-web/tree/bede03d25d232826e0c9dca1733d542d8a7754fb . This is the gitHead recorded by npm for lottie-web 5.13.0; the vendored runtime is assets/vendor/lottie-light-5.13.0.min.js.
sections.installation:
1. Back up and test on staging.
  2. Deactivate the separate Digiter Builder commercial edition, if installed.
  3. Upload the ZIP through Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin and activate it.
  4. Open Digiter Builder > Open editor. Create, preview, save and publish a page.

Lite 1.0.2 upgrades earlier Lite storage to its own digibl-prefixed names. Back up your site before upgrading. Lite cannot edit documents using modules outside its catalogue. Do not downgrade advanced commercial layouts to Lite or use Lite as an automatic edition switch. Do not run both editions together.
sections.faq:
Is a paid license required?

No. All included functionality is free and does not expire.

Will deactivation delete pages?

No. Layout data is retained. Pages relying on Builder need an active compatible edition to render their layouts.

Is AI included?

No. The Lite package contains no AI API client.
sections.changelog:
1.0.5

  • Make the website and Full version shop links visible at the beginning of the description and provide the product homepage link.

1.0.4

  • Add optional Full version purchase links and clear checkout, installation and edition-transition instructions in WordPress.

1.0.3

  • Preserve the site stylesheet registry while rendering isolated previews and saved content.
  • Use WordPress filesystem APIs for local asset installation and cleanup.
  • Clarify narrowly scoped static-analysis exceptions for trusted WordPress output and read-only diagnostics.

1.0.2

  • Use the unique digibl prefix for PHP APIs, options, hooks and editor requests.
  • Upgrade existing Lite storage while preserving layout documents and user CSS.
  • Exclude development Python scripts from the distribution.
  • Read local audio manifests through the WordPress JSON file helper.

1.0.1

  • Use WordPress stylesheet APIs for generated layouts, previews and local fonts.
  • Validate client addresses and request URLs; restrict editor cache bypass to authorized requests.
  • Harden diagnostic JSON export and remove promotion of filtered content into the document head.
  • Document optional external services and correct the Lottie source link.
  • Use the digiter_builder_content_changed integration action.
  • Keep diagnostics local; remove the unused external reporting client and key settings.

1.0.0

  • Initial standalone free edition derived from Digiter Builder 2.0.2.
  • Free authoring, a focused module/template catalogue, and WordPress.org updates.
